claims.text: Each SQL statement sees a snapshot of the data as it was at some earlier moment, regardless of the current state of the underlying rows.

claims.text: In MVCC, locks taken for reading don't conflict with locks taken for writing, so reading never blocks writing and writing never blocks reading.

cut.text: ROLLBACK in PostgreSQL takes constant time regardless of transaction size.
cut.reason: no official doc states it; page only says rollback marks the transaction aborted and leaves its versions

cut.text: Running VACUUM right after a bulk load sets hint bits so the first query doesn't pay.
cut.reason: not confirmed in official docs for this purpose

cut.text: GitLab's replicas slowed once more than 64 subtransactions were open.
cut.reason: the post's numeric details could not be confirmed in a second read; page only cites the symptom, trigger and fix

cut.text: Django's nested atomic() and Rails' requires_new use SAVEPOINT.
cut.reason: framework docs not checked in this pass; page tells the reader to check their ORM instead
